notes: GEO ACCESSION: GSE138252, PCM1+ cardiomyocyte-nuclei bulk RNA-seq, 48 GSMs / 38 library columns. VERIFIED DESIGN: the series summary states PCM1-based cardiomyocyte-specific nuclear isolation, every GSM's extract protocol says PCM1+ cardiomyocyte nuclei, and the `molecule subtype` characteristic is 'Cardiomyoyte-specific nuclear RNA' (sic), so this is CM-nuclear bulk, not whole tissue. The primary payload is the 2020-batch matrix (56,609 genes x 18 human atrial libraries: LA 5 AF + 5 CTL, RA 5 AF + 3 CTL); GSM4103429 (h76ra) has no expression row; the 2021 addendum re-sequences four 2020 hearts and adds 6 HF-only libraries and 14 controls, and the 2785 matrix is a 6-column technical-replicate subset, so 48 GSMs -> 38 distinct library columns. CHOSEN MODEL: left atrium, 2020 batch only, 5 AF vs 5 CTL (batch-matched; region is the dominant variance axis and the AF arm exists only in the 2020 batch). CONFOUND: the AF arm is AF + end-stage HF and the controls are non-failing donor hearts, so AF-CTL is AF+HF vs NF; the HF-only arm is batch-separated from AF, so an AF-vs-HF contrast is not identifiable. MEASURED v2 DEGs: 1 (SLC9A7 up, padj 0.0404), 1 gene at padj<0.05, 62 at padj<0.10. The pre-existing audit's limma-voom WITH edgeR TMM gives 2 (SLC9A7, LRRC10) and its edgeR QL gives 6; TMM is the only difference and it is recorded as a sensitivity, never published, because the pinned arc R env ships limma but not edgeR and the one live implementation uses voom's own library-size normalisation (Lead's one-live-implementation ruling). BUILD: capped 10 GiB RLIMIT_AS, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; peak RSS 191 MB, wall 4.5 s. REPRODUCTION: script/fetch.sh -> script/verify.sh -> script/build_deg.py; a second build is byte-identical.
purpose: Human atrial cardiomyocyte-nuclei (PCM1+ FANS-sorted) bulk RNA-seq source for the Stage 2 gene axis under ADR 0071: the left-atrium, 2020-batch 5 AF vs 5 control contrast, fitted with the one live DEG implementation (limma-voom). Tier-1 AF source because the libraries are cardiomyocyte nuclei, not whole tissue.

sources.method: script/fetch.sh (curl from the GEO FTP series matrix/ and suppl/ directories): the series matrix plus the three series-level supplementary count matrices, byte-identical to the FTP listing. The deposit has no per-sample supplementary file.
